localpack-bypass.screen.title: Server resource packs
localpack-bypass.screen.message:
The server sent new or changed resource packs: %s%s.
Press the button to download everything you need at once. The packs are saved to the resourcepacks folder and enabled automatically.

If you decline, you will be disconnected from the server.
localpack-bypass.disconnect: You declined to download the server's resource packs
localpack-bypass.update.title: Mod update
localpack-bypass.update.message:
Version %s of Local Resource Pack Cache is available, you have %s.

Download it? The old version is replaced and the game has to be restarted.
localpack-bypass.update.installed: Version %s is installed. Restart the game to use it.
localpack-bypass.update.queued: Version %s is downloaded and verified. The old version is removed when you close the game, then restart.
localpack-bypass.update.queuedManual: Version %s is downloaded and verified, but the old jar could not be replaced automatically. Remove it by hand and move the new jar into mods: %s
localpack-bypass.update.dev: Running from a development environment, updates are disabled.
localpack-bypass.update.failed: The update could not be installed: %s
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.localpack: Downloads server resource packs with one button, saves them to resourcepacks and enables them automatically. If a pack is already downloaded, you join without any prompts.
